board:
Create a production-quality UI component DESIGN SPECIFICATION BOARD for Cyrene, a Chinese personal AI assistant. This is ONE coherent design system sheet, not alternative concepts. Use the attached Cyrene screenshot as a visual-style reference: neutral charcoal background #111214, panels #191a1d, hairline #34353a borders, restrained warm coral #cc9184 and cyan #62c8cd, legible near-white Chinese text. Clean Manrope and Noto Sans SC / PingFang-style type. No gradients, no ornamental graphics, no fake 3D. Target dimensions 1800 x 1500, natural landscape ratio. Current date anchor 2026-11-07; no calendar dates needed.
This board documents reusable card SHAPES, not the app sidebar or dashboard. Large title at upper left: "Cyrene · 卡片系统". Subtitle: "6 种预定义形态 + 1 种自由生成". Small upper-right identifier "DESIGN SPEC / 01".
A generous 3-column by 2-row grid contains SIX equally sized realistic interactive card components. Each numbered label sits OUTSIDE its actual card. All cards share a restrained shell: icon + specific title on the left, tiny updated status and ellipsis / pin actions on the right, divided from the body by subtle spacing. Use ample 24px internal padding and clear 14–16px equivalent body text. Short exact Chinese copy:
1 label "01  摘要 / 文本". Card title "杭州旅行建议". Two short lines "沿西湖慢慢走，给茶园留半天。" and "先确定日期，再调整每日安排。" Below a subtle source link "查看依据".
2 label "02  清单 / 进度". Card title "出发前的准备". A compact three-row checkbox list: checked "确定出行日期", unchecked "选择住宿区域", unchecked "确认预约". Small footer "已完成 1 / 3".
3 label "03  表格 / 对比". Card title "住宿区域对比". A simple 3-column table with headers "区域 / 交通 / 氛围", rows "湖滨 / 便利 / 热闹", "龙井 / 一般 / 安静". One row softly selected, no nested cards.
4 label "04  指标 / 数据". Card title "旅行预算". Large metric "¥1,500", smaller "/ ¥2,000". Small horizontal breakdown "住宿 600 · 餐饮 400 · 其他 500". Green "剩余 ¥500". No invented real-time status.
5 label "05  表单 / 选择". Card title "补充旅行偏好". Three segmented controls "轻松 / 均衡 / 紧凑" with 轻松 selected. One short field "预算 ¥2,000". Clear button "应用偏好".
6 label "06  地图 / 地点". Card title "西湖周边". Realistically styled illustrative Hangzhou West Lake map thumbnail with lake, roads and three coral location markers, small footer "3 个地点 · 查看地图". It is a conceptual map image, not claimed live geography.
Below the grid a larger WIDE seventh card with OUTSIDE label "07  自定义 / iframe". This is a working-looking arbitrary mini-app generated by the Agent, visually proving it is different from the six predefined shapes. Card title "旅行节奏编辑器", small badge "自定义". Inside: a designed horizontal timeline "09:30 西湖" → "12:00 午餐" → "14:00 茶园", a slider labeled "松弛程度", and button "应用到行程". It has an airy paper-like warm-white body contrasting with the shared dark shell, refined thin strokes and coral controls. To its RIGHT, a narrow specification annotation area on the same board states "Agent 生成 HTML / CSS / JS", "在 iframe 内运行", "共用同一套标题与位置菜单". These are outside the user-facing mini-app body.
At the very bottom, one concise shared-rule strip: "统一外壳：标题 · 更新状态 · 操作 · 展示位置" then "仅在对话中显示  /  固定到右侧". Indicate Agent AND user can choose placement with exact text "Agent 与用户均可选择位置". A note "示例数据" small and understated.
Editorial product-design sheet, crisp pixels, restrained spacing, no extra panels or types. Exactly six standard shapes and one custom iframe card. Render Chinese accurately and keep all contents inside their cards. Preserve the Cyrene palette and typography from the attached visual reference.
screen:
Edit the attached Cyrene app screenshots into a high-fidelity next iteration of the SAME desktop app. Reference image 1 (original user screenshot) is authoritative for the LEFT SIDEBAR; keep its search toolbar, four entries "分屏实验 · 浏览器", "分屏实验 · 文件", "split-check.md", "助理工具验证", timestamps, and bottom dock "日程 / 工作 / Cyrene / 知识库 / 记忆" unchanged in identity, order and relative layout. Reference image 2 (current prototype) supplies refined typography and the three-column shell. This is ONE completed product UI design, not a poster or concept sheet. Target 1586 x 992, match reference 2 ratio and sizing. Current date anchor 2026-11-07, no new calendar dates. Dark charcoal #111214, #191a1d panels, hairline gray borders, restrained coral #cc9184, cyan #62c8cd brand, off-white text. No gradients or futuristic effects. Beautiful readable 14–16px body type, purposeful whitespace, exact Chinese labels.
Keep original left sidebar ~300px. Keep top Cyrene branding and compact tabs. CENTER ~900px is now a conversation with embedded interactive cards, RIGHT ~320px is a permanent pinned-card shelf. The same card content can appear in conversation and right shelf, with expanded vs compact presentations.
Top center title "杭州周末旅行". Small subtitle "对话与卡片，一起完成任务". One user bubble near top: "去杭州玩两天，预算 2000 元，安排轻松一点。". Assistant single line: "我整理了地图和预算，也为你生成了一个节奏编辑器。"
Center card 1: title "杭州旅行地图", a small coral "已固定" pin-state control on the right, a clean real-looking illustrated West Lake map about 200px tall, three pins and a short route. Under map short row "西湖 · 龙井 · 河坊街". Small muted "示例地图" label. No fabricated real-time claims.
Center card 2 directly below: same dark outer card shell, title "旅行节奏编辑器", tiny cyan "自定义" badge, ellipsis and pin menu on top right. Inside a warm pale paper colored bespoke interactive mini-app, independently styled, with 3 timeline stops "09:30 西湖 / 12:00 午餐 / 14:00 茶园"; one horizontal slider "松弛程度"; button "应用到行程". This is Agent-generated iframe content. Do NOT expose iframe, HTML, sandbox or developer code terminology in the user-facing app.
A single OPEN placement dropdown anchored to this second card's top-right action, clearly readable, with heading "展示位置", a selected check beside "仅在对话中显示", and a pin beside "固定到右侧". No other floating menus. This exact menu communicates placement choice; it should not obscure primary card content. Beneath the custom card, subtle status "由 Cyrene 生成 · 刚刚更新". These two center cards fit above the pinned composer.
Bottom center fixed input "继续告诉 Cyrene 你的想法…" with attachment, current-task chip and coral circular send arrow, consistent with original shell.
RIGHT rail header "常驻卡片", small pin icon and plus button. Supporting text "Agent 和你，都可以把内容留在这里". Exactly THREE compact cards:
A "杭州旅行地图", compact thumbnail of the SAME lake map, pin icon, small provenance "你固定的". Show same three places.
B "旅行预算", large "¥1,500 / ¥2,000", breakdown rows "住宿 ¥600", "餐饮 ¥400", "其他 ¥500", green "剩余 ¥500", small provenance "Cyrene 固定" and "演示估算". This demonstrates Agent-selected sidebar placement distinct from user pinning.
C "出行准备", three compact checklist items, provenance "你固定的". No conversation bubbles in right rail.
Every right card has collapse, unpin/return-to-chat menu affordances. Rail footer small "3 张常驻 · 自动保存". Avoid duplicated nested boxes. All controls look plausible and implementation-ready. Preserve left sidebar strictly. The scene should communicate: predefined shapes plus freely generated custom content, both user and Agent can choose chat-only or sidebar, pinning preserves content while conversation continues. No architecture diagrams, no captions outside the app.
